_comment: CONSTRAINT-AWARE GLOBAL sigma0 (docs/SPEC_prior_residual_census.md §14) -- THE
ARM THE CARD IS GRADED ON.  Extends _ft63_s0g_raimlive_off.json; the ONLY
delta is network.prior_residual_global_sigma0 (plus the run paths).
This is the only shipped arm where BOTH SIDES OF THE STATISTIC ARE LIVE:
* DATA side  -- phase_leveling is on (2-epoch warmup), so carry_warm becomes
true and the post-fit RAIM row walk actually runs; raim_redundancy_normalize
is on, so each row carries a real Baarda r_i and Sum-r_data is a redundancy
rather than a row count.  No APPROX flag, no NO_DATA flag.
* PRIOR side -- the census's folded rows, all five families armed.  On this
lineage pl is LIVE (it is a phase_leveling lineage), which the census's own
build record lists as its single largest open gap.
WHAT IT MEASURES.  sigma0_global is LASER 5-74's constraint-aware scale --
prior residuals in the numerator, constraints in the redundancy -- against which
the network's own within-epoch sigma0 (a ROBUST MEDIAN of standardized DATA-row
residuals) can finally be compared.  prior_tension_ratio = Sum w*e^2 / Sum w*v^2
is the headline: how much of the epoch's weighted misfit lives in the CARRY, the
quantity the median sigma0 is structurally blind to.
MEASURE-ONLY: the A4 raim_withhold_sigma0 guard, every gate and every deweight
stay on the median sigma0.  The solve must be byte-identical to the OFF arm.
READ THE FLAGS COLUMN FIRST.  s0g_flags is the in-band degradation bitmask
(1 APPROX r==1, 2 NO_DATA, 4 NO_PRIOR, 8 DEGENERATE, 16 RNEG_DROP).  On this arm
it should be 0 on every settled epoch; a non-zero value means the number in that
row is degraded in a NAMED direction and the run-end line repeats the tally.
10-EPOCH LIMITS.  This is a smoke and establishes gate 1 (byte-identity) and the
live-wiring half only.  The spec's gate 2 (THE TRIANGLE: sigma0_global vs the
median sigma0 vs M2's per-family robust sigma-hat, which must reconcile to about
a factor of 2) and gate 3 (THE CLIFF: prior_tension must spike with the M2
family spikes at hr-4 while the median sigma0 stays comparatively flat) need a
CONVERGED WARM window.  During ignition a free ambiguity absorbs its own arc's
misfit exactly, so BOTH the statistic and its calibration are structurally
distorted -- and the sigma0 warm-up (200 rows) has not been cleared, so every
census t is still the raw formal s.  Chain this arm onto a seed snapshot (legal:
the card is fingerprint-SAFE) and grade only the resumed leg.  Do NOT quote a
tension ratio from a cold 10-epoch run.
